question: Which hormone favors the mobilization of aquaporins 2 to the luminal membrane in the renal tubule ?:
analysis: The hormone that favors the mobilization of aquaporins 2 to the luminal membrane in the renal tubule is the antidiuretic hormone (ADH), also known as vasopressin. ADH acts on the kidneys to increase water reabsorption by inserting aquaporin-2 channels into the luminal membrane of the renal tubules.
